evidence.sample: Season to date, through 2026-10-31: 452 official starts in the 5 matchup weeks used. Week 1: 50 goalies, 78 starts; Week 2: 57 goalies, 94 starts; Week 3: 59 goalies, 100 starts; Week 4: 57 goalies, 96 starts; Week 5: 56 goalies, 84 starts. Comparisons not available: 0. Relief-only goalies, not compared: 5. Avg ADP is the mean of Yahoo's average pick for the goalies shown, from this season's Yahoo row only. An undrafted goalie, or one with no numeric pick, 0, "-", null or no Yahoo match, counts as the highest average pick of any player in yahoo_players, in any season, rounded up to the next 10: 192 gives 200
evidence.cohort: 71 goalies with at least 1 official start; baselines use every goalie with a start, week by week. Ranked by Category Counts: games net (better minus worse results), then week net, then share better; equal goalies share a rank; lower GAA counts as better. TGV grade (existing method) is a separate method, not applied to Category Counts; Average cannot occur with its three default stats. Season to date uses Category Counts' month rules over every matchup week started. Game cells cover every start, each against its own matchup week's baseline, and every started week gives week cells; the week under way counts through the data's last date
